speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I’m Dr. Agent. To help us figure out what's going on with your tremors and memory, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if they seem to be getting worse? Also, have you noticed any other changes, like stiffness in your limbs or difficulties with balance?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the tremor occur when your hand is resting, or does it mainly happen when you are trying to use it, like when reaching for a cup? Have you also noticed any slowing of your movements, rigidity, or changes in your sense of smell or sleep?

text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

text: Do you experience any balance issues or frequent falls, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation? Additionally, do you have any history of hallucinations or significant mood changes like depression or anxiety?
